title: `extractWatchHints` reads a noise-floor EXCLUSION constant as a watch hint: `.changeset` derives `check:pm-half-states` onto every changeset-adding card
body:
Noticed while re-measuring `lint.yml`'s `PM half-state sweeper self-test` reason
comment for #15537. #15537's ruling holds that card to the comment and fences
both `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` and `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, so
this is filed rather than fixed there.

## The reading

`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` declares a two-spelling noise floor for the
H36 shared-file rule -- paths that must be EXCLUDED from pairing because they
collide across every PR:

```
scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs:6543  export const H36_SHARED_PATH_NOISE   = Object.freeze(['pnpm-lock.yaml']);
scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs:6544  export const H36_SHARED_PREFIX_NOISE = Object.freeze(['.changeset/']);
```

`extractWatchHints` reads the second one as a watch hint -- a surface the gate
WATCHES -- which is the exact inverse of what the constant means. Measured on
`origin/main` (worktree at 95bf71449, comments-only diff to `lint.yml`):

```
extractWatchHints(check-half-states.mjs) =>
  ["objectstack-ai/objectstack", ".changeset", "scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs", "owner/name"]

hintCovers('.changeset', '.changeset/foo.md')  =>  true
'.changeset' covers 84 tracked file(s) (counted over `git ls-files`)

node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs .changeset/foo.md --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack
  - pnpm check:pm-half-states   [lint.yml]   matched via .changeset/foo.md ⇢ gate source '.changeset'
```

Every user-visible PR in this repo adds a `.changeset/*.md`, so that derivation
lands on essentially every card.

## Why it is worth a card rather than a shrug

The COST today is small and #15537 accepts it as-is: what gets derived is one
offline self-test, no network, no token, ~0.05s, green. What is worth fixing is
the CLASS -- an exclusion list read as an inclusion surface -- because the size
of the mistake is set by the spelling that happens to be in the constant, not by
anything anyone chose. A noise floor that later grows a broader prefix scales
this silently, and the hint reader has no way to tell watch-this from
never-pair-on-this.

There is already a precedent for the fix shape: the OTHER spelling in the same
noise floor is handled.

```
hintCovers('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'pnpm-lock.yaml')                      =>  false
'pnpm-lock.yaml' is not extracted as a hint from this script at all =>  true
```

So `dispatch-gates` already knows lockfile-shaped shared noise and drops it. The
open question is whether `.changeset` joins it by the same mechanism, whether
the constants get an opt-out marker the extractor honours, or whether this gate
simply gets its own gate file like `check:pm-dispatch-gates` next door.

⛔ Not judged here -- filed as an observation, not a prescription. Nothing is
red and nothing is broken; the derived gate passes.

## Re-check

```
node -e "const m = await import('./scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs'); const fs = await import('node:fs'); console.log(m.extractWatchHints(fs.readFileSync('scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs','utf8'), 'scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs'))" --input-type=module
node -e "const m = await import('./scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs'); console.log(m.hintCovers('.changeset', '.changeset/foo.md'), m.hintCovers('pnpm-lock.yaml', 'pnpm-lock.yaml'))" --input-type=module
```

Duplicate check: 617 open items (584 issues) enumerated by page over the
repo-scoped REST list endpoint and grepped locally for `H36_SHARED_PREFIX_NOISE`
and for noise-floor/watch-hint prose; control word `exactly ONE hint` verified to
hit exactly the card it should (#15537) and nothing else. REST `search/issues` is
403 in this session ("sessions are bound to their configured repositories"), so
the list endpoint was the channel. No match.

Unassigned, unlabeled -- for PM triage.
